name: Constraint
label: Requirements / use case
description: Name the hard requirement before choosing a service.

name: Data-Prepare
label: Prepare data
description: Validate, fail or quarantine, and verify required redaction before downstream use.

name: Data-Ingest
label: Ingest / embed / index
description: Preserve evidence, compatible vectors, versions, and trusted access metadata.

name: Select
label: Select
description: Compare supported choices using representative held-out inputs and the actual constraints.

name: Adapt-Prompt
label: Runtime: prompt / context
description: Change instructions, examples, templates, or supplied conversation context.

name: Adapt-RAG
label: Runtime: RAG / retrieval
description: Change the evidence, query, retrieval, ranking, or context-selection path.

name: Adapt-FineTune
label: Model: customize / train
description: Consider supported weight changes only for an evaluated behavior need.

name: Evaluate
label: Evaluate / approve
description: Compare with the baseline; validate cohorts, source support, task outcomes, and approval.

name: Deploy
label: Deploy / controlled exposure
description: Apply the approved compatible release, control exposure, and verify rollback.

name: Monitor
label: Monitor / feedback
description: Collect outcomes and evidence; route demonstrated regressions back to selection or adaptation.
